checklist: Go to Menu > password 8808 > Network > BACnet Settings and change BACnet Protocol from Off to BACnet/IP, MS/TP Master or MS/TP Slave; the controller restarts.
Set the Node ID (default 1001) and either the IP settings (DHCP by default, falling back to 169.254.x.x) or the MS/TP MAC (default 127) and baud, fitting JP6 only on the first and last device.
Under Controls > Signal Settings set Source to BACnet and pick the Control Mode, and set Remote Enable to BACnet if the BMS will enable the unit.
Discover device 1001 and read MI 5154 (Device Status), MI 5155 (Error Status) and AI 10020 (ErrorWarning Code).
Write BV 5187 (Remote Enable) = 1 and a demand or RH value to AO 15059 (Rh or Demand), then watch MI 5154 and AI 15174 (Actual Hum. Capacity).
Program the BMS to rewrite AO 15059 well inside the Signal Timeout (default 300 s), or warning W35 stops the unit.
Remember that releasing AO 15059 drops it to its relinquish default of 0, which takes demand to zero.
Map MI 5155, AI 10020 and BI 5002 (Safety Loop) as alarms and trend AI 10060 (Next Maintenance).
